title: ios-acceptance-release
responsibility: Owns the ios-acceptance-release build or maintenance script.

inputs.name: releaseRefusal.run
inputs.description: The required `Acceptance` value passed to `releaseRefusal`; the function reads its `record` and `page` properties and passes the same run to its helpers. It must meet the imported `Acceptance` type; this implementation does not create a run or fill in omitted fields.

outputs.name: releaseRefusal
outputs.description: The Promise resolves after the Release flow has restarted, located the connection panel, recorded the two checks, and completed `cameraOnly(run, 'Release')`. It resolves to `undefined` and returns no result payload.

errors.name: Unspecified propagated rejection
errors.description: Exceptions from calls made by this function are not caught; if a call throws or rejects, the async result propagates that failure. The implementation does not specify a concrete error class or name.
